# dnsgate_team (Data Source)

One team of the gate policy (`GET /api/v1/teams/{team}`): where it comes from, its members and roles, what it owns per zone and its pending ownership transfers. Fails if the gate does not know the team; empty, with a warning, on gates without teams.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dnsgate_team" "web" {
  name = "web"
}

output "web_rrsets_per_zone" {
  value = { for o in data.dnsgate_team.web.owned : o.zone => o.rrsets }
}

output "web_pending_transfers" {
  value = [for t in data.dnsgate_team.web.pending_transfers : "${t.from_team} -> ${t.to_team} (${t.zone})"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `family` (Attributes) Derivation of a `family` team, null otherwise. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--family))
- `issuer` (String) Issuer of a `claim` team.
- `kind` (String) Where the team comes from: `declared` (teams block of the gate configuration or of its managed policy), `auto` (named by a binding or a virtual key without being declared, during the migration to the teams block), `family` (teams derived from a claim by `team_from`, name `<prefix>*`), `claim` (teams taken from the `team_claim` of an issuer, name `*`), `store` (owns RRsets but named nowhere in the policy).
- `layer` (String) `base` (gate configuration file) or `managed` (managed policy) for declared teams, empty otherwise.
- `members` (Attributes) Members of a declared team. Null unless the identity holds `policy.read` in the gate, and for teams that are not declared. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `owned` (Attributes List) What the team owns per zone, among the zones the identity can read, sorted by zone. Tombstones are RRsets the team deleted recently, still reserved for it. The gate caches these counts for up to a minute. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owned))
- `pending_transfers` (Attributes List) Ownership transfer requests from or to the team waiting for approval. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pending_transfers))
- `roles` (List of String) Roles of the bindings and virtual keys naming the team.
- `rrsets` (Number) RRsets owned in the readable zones, in total.
- `virtual_keys` (List of String) Virtual keys acting for the team.
- `warning` (String) Why the gate flags the team (for example undeclared), empty otherwise.

<a id="nestedatt--pending_transfers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pending_transfers`

Read-Only:

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339.
- `from_team` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `kind` (String) `rrsets` (RRsets of one zone) or `rename` (every RRset of a team).
- `requester` (String)
- `rrsets` (List of String) `<name>/<type>` of the RRsets.
- `to_team` (String)
- `zone` (String) Empty for a rename.
